summary: REA of Pro CPS 1.3.3 (exe sha256 1a20aa53...): NewChirp encoder matches SetCHInfo_Parameter byte for byte; CPS TX range 18-1000 MHz with no amateur-band limit; no radio-wide TX-inhibit setting; blank TX (FF x4) is the only per-channel TX-off. NewChirp's marine template defaults to receive-only (Duplex off -> TX FF), matching 'beeps on every channel' for an all-marine load. Leading cause: template default, not a write defect. Reverted the incorrect 144-148/420-450 TX-band warning.
